text.text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
If children live honestly, and have wherewithal, they shall cover the baseness of their parents.
An honest man is surety for his neighbour: but he that is impudent will forsake him.
Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
